value.rationale: The focal paper explicitly asks whether its quadratic constants can be improved. On its canonical non-semicontinuous example family, the result determines the exact best constant simultaneously for demicontinuity, order-continuous-dual norming, Lorentz completion, and an extension norm. This provides a sharp benchmark showing that the quadratic loss is not intrinsic in a natural motivating family rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
